description: This Java class defines the configuration for default tags used in a persistence layer, specifically for handling 'tags' related settings, including retrieving configuration values and providing object equality, hash code, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultTagsConfig
classes.description: Immutable Java class for managing tags configuration, primarily the streaming cache size.

methods.name: DefaultTagsConfig.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultTagsConfig based on provided Config.

methods.name: getStreamingCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the streaming cache.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on streamingCacheSize.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the object.
